About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Plasterer — Wall & Ceiling Linings to join our team on a full-time basis in Townsville, Queensland.
The successful applicant will work on a range of commercial construction projects, including fit-outs, refurbishments and new building works. This role requires a skilled tradesperson with strong experience in wall and ceiling linings, plasterboard installation, suspended ceiling systems and commercial construction site requirements.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

The successful applicant will be responsible for:
•	Reading and interpreting construction drawings, plans and specifications
•	Measuring, marking and cutting plasterboard, fibre cement sheeting, ceiling tiles and lining materials
•	Installing plasterboard wall linings, partitions, bulkheads and ceiling systems
•	Installing suspended ceilings, grid systems, acoustic ceiling tiles and associated framing
•	Fixing plasterboard, fibre cement, acoustic and composite wall linings to walls, ceilings and battens
•	Setting joints, internal and external angles, corner beads and trims
•	Applying compounds, tapes and finishing materials to achieve smooth, level surfaces
•	Installing fire-rated and acoustic wall and ceiling systems in accordance with project specifications
•	Carrying out patching, repairs and finishing works as required
•	Ensuring work is completed to a high standard and in accordance with workplace health and safety requirements
•	Working collaboratively with site supervisors, builders, subcontractors and other trades
•	Maintaining tools, equipment and a clean, safe work area

Skills and Experience Required

Applicants must have:
•	Trade qualification in plastering, wall and ceiling lining, or a closely related field; or at least 3 years of relevant trade experience
•	Demonstrated experience as a plasterer or wall and ceiling liner, preferably in commercial construction
•	Experience installing plasterboard walls, ceilings, suspended ceiling systems and associated framing
•	Ability to read and interpret plans, drawings and specifications
•	Strong understanding of commercial construction site procedures and workplace health and safety requirements
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team
•	Good attention to detail and ability to deliver high-quality finishes
•	Current construction White Card
•	Own basic trade tools
•	Driver licence & reliable transport required

What We Offer
•	Full-time employment. 
•	Annual salary of $80,000 plus superannuation.

•	Opportunity to work on varied and high-quality commercial projects. 

How to Apply
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant plastering, wall lining and ceiling lining experience.

Team:				Fresh Meats
Location:			Clayton, Victoria
Reports to:			Boning Room Supervisor
Salary:				$80,000 - $85,000 Per Annum (Excl Superannuation)

Skilled Meat Worker
Join the Tibaldi team as a full-time Skilled Meat Worker based in Clayton, Victoria.

Our Story
Founded in 1934, the Tibaldi family of butchers had a dream to provide Australian’s with only the finest cuts of meats processed the traditional way using authentic Italian recipes.

90 years later not much has changed. Today, Tibaldi are a major supplier to the retail, route and food service industry across Australia. The company’s state of the art facilities in Clayton excel industry standards using leading technology. 

The product range spans across traditional Italian salami, ham, bacon, traditional smallgoods, fresh meat including a range of Outdoor Bred pork.

That’s Tradition. That’s Tibaldi.

Responsibilities and Duties
As a Skilled Meat Worker at Tibaldi you will be part of the Fresh Meats team based in Clayton, Victoria and will be involved in:

•	Using equipment to move carcasses and meat to boning and cutting tables
•	Trim, wash, and clean meat, removing blood, fat, and unwanted material
•	Cut carcasses into standard meat cuts like rumps, shoulders, and flanks
•	Remove internal fat, blood clots, bruises, and other waste materials
•	Operate restrainers and stunning equipment safely
•	Remove heads and head meat where required
•	Perform evisceration and trimming of carcasses

As part of our Fresh Meats team, you will have:

•	AQF Certificate III in Meat Processing
•	Skilled in the humane and efficient slaughter of livestock.
•	Follows strict safety procedures and demonstrates clear, effective communication skills.
•	Previous experience for a minimum of 2 years in a meat processing environment
•	The knowledge of food safety and hygiene standards
•	An understanding of humane animal handling
•	The ability to follow detailed procedures and demonstrates clear, effective communication skills.

Our Ways of Working
Our hourly rates of pay are dependent upon your levels of experience.

As part of our Tibaldi team you will be able to:
•	Participate in our Tibaldi Team Product Orders program that enables you to purchase our products at a below-retail price
•	Access free on-site car parking
•	Access our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
•	Participate in training and development courses tailored to your needs; both on-site and off-site
•	Travel to work on public transport as we are conveniently located close to public transport including Westall or Clayton train stations

Pre-Employment Medical
A pre-employment medical will form part of the recruitment process.

External Recruitment
Candidates interested in this position should apply directly to this advertisement as we
are not accepting applications from recruitment agencies at this time.

www.tibaldi.com.au #tibaldi

result.description:
## Network Analyst
## Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced and analytical Network Analyst to join our team and play a key role in maintaining, optimising, and evolving our organisation's network infrastructure. The successful candidate will be responsible for researching and analysing network architecture, recommending strategies for network design and planning, and ensuring systems operate at peak performance. This role suits a detail-oriented professional with a strong technical background who is equally comfortable working on strategic planning as they are on day-to-day network operations. You will collaborate closely with IT teams and stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable network solutions across the organisation.
## Key Responsibilities
- Analyse, develop, and evaluate complex network architecture, system design specifications, data models, and diagrams to support the configuration, integration, and ongoing development of computer systems
- Research, monitor, and assess network infrastructure to ensure all systems are correctly configured and consistently operating at optimal performance levels
- Monitor network traffic, activity, capacity, and usage on an ongoing basis to maintain network integrity, identify anomalies, and proactively address performance issues before they escalate
- Identify opportunities for improvement across network operations and recommend enhancements to integrated hardware, software, communications, and operating systems
- Design, plan, and coordinate network architecture strategies that align with the organisation's broader technology goals and operational requirements
- Perform routine and scheduled network maintenance, including software and hardware upgrades, patch management, and system backups to ensure continuity and resilience
- Troubleshoot and resolve network faults, connectivity issues, and performance degradation, providing timely support to internal teams and end users
- Develop and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including topology diagrams, configuration records, and operational procedures
- Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends, providing informed recommendations on tools and solutions that could improve network capability and efficiency
- Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams, vendors, and stakeholders to support infrastructure projects, system integrations, and technology upgrades
- Contribute to the development and enforcement of network policies, standards, and security protocols to safeguard the organisation's data and systems
- Assist in capacity planning and forecasting to ensure the network infrastructure can support current and future organisational demands
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in a network analysis, network engineering, or similar IT infrastructure role
- Strong working knowledge of networking protocols, technologies, and concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, BGP, and OSPF
- Proven experience monitoring and managing enterprise network environments using industry-standard tools and platforms
- Solid understanding of network security principles, firewalls, access controls, and best practices
- Experience with network hardware from leading vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, or Palo Alto
- Ability to analyse complex technical data, interpret performance metrics, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve network issues efficiently under pressure
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work autonomously, and contribute effectively within a team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent vendor-specific credentials
- Experience working within large-scale or enterprise-level network environments
- Familiarity with cloud networking platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
- Knowledge of network automation tools and scripting languages such as Python or Ansible
- Experience with SD-WAN technologies and software-defined networking concepts
- Exposure to ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed service provider (MSP) environment
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking technology team that values innovation and continuous improvement
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications and training programmes
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with hybrid arrangements available to support work-life balance
- Competitive remuneration package with clearly defined career progression pathways
- Work on diverse and meaningful infrastructure projects that directly impact the performance and reliability of the wider organisation
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

result.description:
Dubbo Grain Packing (DGP)
Grain Storage & Handling Site, Trangie, NSW 2823

Full Time General Clerk
$98,000 per annum plus superannuation

Summary
The General Clerk provides administrative and clerical support to the operations of Dubbo
Grain Packing (DGP). The position is responsible for maintaining records, processing
documentation, data entry, preparing correspondence, coordinating office activities, and
supporting grain storage and handling operations through efficient administrative services.

Duties and Responsibilities

General Administrative Support
•	Perform a range of clerical and administrative duties to support site operations.
•	Prepare, process and file business documents, forms and correspondence.
•	Maintain electronic and physical filing systems.
•	Receive, sort and distribute incoming mail and communications.
•	Assist management with routine administrative tasks.

Record Keeping and Data Entry
•	Enter and update operational information into company databases and record systems.
•	Maintain records relating to grain receivals, dispatches and inventory movements.
•	Verify information for accuracy and completeness.
•	Retrieve records and documents as requested by management.
•	Ensure records are maintained in accordance with company procedures.

Document Preparation
•	Prepare routine reports, spreadsheets, forms and correspondence.
•	Compile operational data for management reporting purposes.
•	Assist with preparation of meeting agendas, minutes and administrative documentation.
•	Maintain document registers and administrative records.

Customer and Stakeholder Liaison
•	Respond to routine enquiries from customers, suppliers, transport operators and
•	contractors.
•	Direct enquiries to appropriate personnel when required.
•	Provide administrative support to visitors and site personnel.
•	Maintain professional communication with internal and external stakeholders.

Operational Administration Support
•	Assist with processing grain receival and dispatch documentation.
•	Maintain weighbridge and transport records.
•	Support scheduling and coordination of administrative activities during harvest periods.
•	Assist operational staff with document management and record maintenance.

Compliance Administration
•	Maintain records required for workplace health and safety, training and compliance
•	purposes.
•	Assist with preparation of documentation for audits and inspections.
•	Ensure administrative records are current, accurate and readily accessible.
•	Support implementation of company policies and procedures.

Reporting
•	Prepare routine administrative and operational reports.
•	Compile statistical information and summaries as requested by management.
•	Assist with monitoring and reporting of administrative activities.

Skills and Competencies
•	Strong administrative and clerical skills.
•	Accurate data entry and record management capability.
•	Sound computer and office software skills.
•	Strong organisational and time management skills.
•	Effective written and verbal communication skills.
•	Attention to detail and accuracy.

Qualifications and Experience
•	Certificate III, Certificate IV or higher qualification in Business Administration or a related field; or
•	At least one year of relevant clerical or administrative experience.
•	At least 12 months experience with a program called Agtech and Agri-digital.


Applications open on 2 July 2026 and close on 1 August 2026

Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

SENIOR PIGGERY STOCKPERSON 
Location: Shea-Oak Log, SA 5371 
Tenure: Full-time Permanent 
Salary: From $71,481 per year (plus superannuation) 

Required Skills and Experience:
•	AQF Certificate III (or higher/equivalent) qualification in Agriculture (Pig Production);
•	At least 3 years recent relevant experience in a medium to large size commercial piggery

Position Summary: 
On behalf of our client, Global Skilled Employment Services is looking for a skilled and experienced Senior Piggery Stockperson who can join the production team of a piggery company with multiple farm sites. 

Must have strong communication and time management skills, self-motivated and must have the ability to work independently and as a member of a team.

Tasks and duties include: 
•	Supervise the site and facilities in terms of the required human resources, physical resources, safety requirements, consumables, documentation and measurement devices
•	Provide overall maintenance and compliance of the Company Quality Assurance program for the site ensuring that all relevant documentation is kept current;
•	Supervise data collection and recording so information is accurate to aid stock and inventory control
•	Undertake specific tasks assigned by management to ensure that environmental, quality and safety goals are met
•	Implement preventable maintenance programs to reduce planned and unplanned down time
•	Supervise trial sheds, collect and record data in accordance with trial protocols
•	Selection of breeding stock and/or pigs for sale
•	Supervision and participation of daily inspection of livestock, such that the animals are appropriately fed, watered, environmental parameters are fulfilled. The Senior Stockperson (Piggery) in this case would work with and supervise a less experienced Stockperson
•	Supervision and participation of daily inspection of livestock, ensuring compromised animals are individually assessed, identified, treated and record in accordance with the Company Herd Health Plan and the industries Model Code of Practice
•	Euthanise sick or injured stock in a humane manner and in accordance with the Model Code of Practice for Animal Welfare – Pigs 3rd edition
•	Conduct post mortem examinations of deceased stock and report findings
•	Supervision and participation in the mating of animals via individually supervised mating or through Artificial Insemination
•	Supervision of the birthing process, including the ability to physically conduct unsupervised internal assessments of females during parturition to minimise this incidence of still births
•	Participate in company/industry training sessions and workshops as required;
•	Perform any other duty as required by the Unit Manager.

Other skills required:
•	Good verbal and written communication skills;
•	Advanced and extensive knowledge in animal husbandry, animal welfare, and pig production;
•	Knowledge in using computer system is an advantage.

Qualified applicants may apply online.

Full-time Cabinet Maker position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team  in Sydney NSW. 

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Cabinet Maker
•	Salary Range: $70,000 - $90,000 per annum plus superannuation
•	Must be qualified or have experience (min 2 yrs) in the industry. 

About Us
Sublime Custom Cabinetry Pty Ltd is a Sydney-based custom joinery and cabinetry business. The company specialises in the design, manufacture, and installation of high-end, bespoke cabinetry for both residential and commercial clients across the Northern Beaches and greater Sydney region.

About the role
The Cabinet Maker constructs, assembles, and installs high-quality custom cabinetry and architectural joinery. The role requires working from detailed shop drawings to produce precise residential and commercial fit-outs. The Cabinet Maker ensures all work meets the quality standards of Sublime Custom Cabinetry Pty Ltd. The role involves both workshop manufacturing and on-site installation.

Duties and Responsibilities

?	Work from CAD drawings and cutting lists.
?	Select, measure, cut, and shape timber, MDF, particleboard, laminates, and veneers.
?	Safely operate workshop machinery including panel saws, edge banders, thicknessers, and CNC routers.
?	Glue, fit, and clamp parts and sub-assemblies together to form complete units.
?	Install hinges, drawer runners, handles, and specialized joinery hardware.
?	Sand surfaces, apply edge banding, and prepare products for final finishing or polishing.
?	Protect client property and prepare the installation area.
?	Securely install cabinetry, benchtops, and joinery items on site.
?	Scribe filler panels and kickboards to fit uneven walls and floors perfectly.
?	Identify and rectify any fitment issues or defects during the installation process.
?	Remove all debris, offcuts, and packaging from the site upon completion.
?	Perform routine maintenance on hand tools, power tools, and workshop machinery.

Essential Skills

?	A strong commitment to producing flawless, high-end finishes.
?	Ability to work collaboratively with apprentices, tradespeople, and management.
?	Capability to meet strict production deadlines without compromising quality.
?	Physically fit

Qualifications needed:

?	Minimum Trade certificate qualification or equivalent relevant work experience
?	Minimum two years of work experience on relevant position

What We Offer

?	Competitive salary based on experience
?	Opportunities for professional growth and training
?	A supportive and dynamic work environment
?	Work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technology

Salary:  The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $70,000-$90,000 plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply: 11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

Immediate Start Available
We are seeking a reliable and motivated MR Truck Driver / Process Worker to join our team. This is a diverse role offering a great mix of driving and hands-on warehouse/processing duties, with approximately 2 days per week driving and 3 days per week process work.

About the Role
This dual-role position is ideal for someone who enjoys variety in their workday. You will be responsible for the safe operation of an MR truck for deliveries, while also supporting our clients processing operations to ensure products are prepared, handled, and dispatched efficiently.

Key Responsibilities
MR Truck Driver Duties (3 Days Per Week)

Safely operate a Medium Rigid (MR) truck.
Complete local deliveries.
Load and unload vehicles as required.
Conduct daily vehicle inspections and maintain logbooks.
Ensure all deliveries are completed safely and on schedule.
Provide professional customer service when dealing with clients and suppliers.

Process Worker Duties (2 Days Per Week)

Operate processing and production equipment.
Sort, prepare, pack, and label products.
Maintain quality standards and follow production procedures.
Assist with stock handling and inventory management.
Keep work areas clean and compliant with workplace safety standards.
Support the wider team with general operational tasks.

About You
To be successful in this role, you will have:

Current MR Truck Licence (essential).
Good driving record and commitment to safe work practices.
Ability to perform physical work, including lifting and manual handling.
Strong work ethic and reliability.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Good communication skills.
Forklift licence (desirable but not essential).
Previous experience in transport, warehouse, manufacturing, or process work highly regarded.

What We Offer

Casual employment with full-time hours.
Varied role with a mix of driving and operational work.
Supportive team environment.
Competitive hourly rate based on experience.
Opportunity for growth and development.

How to Apply
If you are a dependable MR driver looking for a varied role combining driving and process work, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now by submitting your resume OR contact Flexiforce directly on (02) 4869 5505.
